manual_additions.review_note: Opening D3 half note, tied to the following D3 quarter; OMR omitted both heads.
D3 quarter at the end of the opening tie; OMR omitted it.
First bar F-natural after id1 G3; OMR classified the printed natural as key cancellation.
Second bar G3 after the quarter rest, omitted by OMR.
Second bar F-natural after G3; printed natural was classified as key cancellation.
First bar F-sharp printed with explicit sharp, after the opening rest.
Repeated F-sharp at the end of the same bar, after a rest.
First sounding G2 of the system before raw id1 E2.
F-natural half note after raw id2 F-sharp half note.
